payload.title: Score context trials by Brier on returned probabilities
payload.description:
## Purpose

Let the context optimizer choose by calibrated quality (Brier on the model's returned probabilities), not only by accuracy or macro-F1.

## Scope

- Optional `probabilities` field in checkpoint entries (today entries must be exactly `{"label"}`).
- `objective="brier"` in `search_context_policies`; lower is better.
- When a trial lacks probabilities, fall back to accuracy explicitly and record that in the result (no silent mixing).
- Existing checkpoints, objectives and results are unchanged. Phase 1, design build step 2.

## Definition of done

Specs first: exact multiclass Brier on a fixture; old `{"label"}` checkpoints still load; missing-probability fallback is recorded; accuracy and macro-F1 outputs unchanged. `make test` green. Cost: $0.

## Acceptance scenario

```gherkin
Feature: Score context trials by Brier on returned probabilities
  Scenario: Trials with probabilities are ranked by Brier
    Given two context trials whose checkpoints carry label probabilities
    When the optimizer searches with objective brier
    Then the trial with the lower development Brier wins and the objective is recorded
  Scenario: Old checkpoints keep working
    Given a checkpoint whose entries contain only a label
    When it is loaded
    Then it is accepted and accuracy is reported as the fallback objective
```

## Design

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §3.1, §3.2 (Scoring and promotion), §6 step 2.
